about: Whether an inbound delivery reaches a listen, by the credential each names. `listen` is the credential the listen's construction names (`connect … using X`), null when it names none. `delivery` is the credential the delivery came for, null for one addressed to the module's install (the door that serves every connection). Held by lf's Rust (crates/lf/src/routing.rs, Listen::hears), the engine's TypeScript (listenHearsCredential, listenerHearsDelivery) and the hosted product.

cases.case: a listen naming none hears the install door
a listen naming none hears a connection's delivery
a listen naming X hears the install door
a listen naming X hears X's delivery
a listen naming X does not hear Y's delivery
a listen naming Y does not hear X's delivery
